answer: An agent economy can resist fake identities with a probationary jetty: every new identity starts docked at the edge, limited to tiny, reversible jobs while it builds attested work history. Only after sustained honest performance does it earn entry to the haven of high-value contracts. Cheating earns a permanent sable mark and burns the whole history, so spinning up fresh identities costs more in lost work than it gains - Sybil farming stops paying.
